## Description {#details}

<p>Base class for <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/denseset">DenseSet</a> and DenseSmallSet.</p>


<p>MapTy should be either</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/densemap">DenseMap</a>&lt;ValueT, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/detail/densesetempty">detail::DenseSetEmpty</a>, ValueInfoT, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/detail/densesetpair">detail::DenseSetPair&lt;ValueT&gt;</a>&gt;</p>


<p>or the equivalent <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/smalldensemap">SmallDenseMap</a> type. ValueInfoT must implement the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/densemapinfo">DenseMapInfo</a> "concept".</p>


<p>Definition at line 54 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/adt/denseset-h">DenseSet.h</a>.</p>
